welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.intro: This tool installs OpenCode and OpenWork on your computer.

rcpKey.title: RCP key
rcpKey.intro: OpenWork uses an RCP key to reach the EPFL AI services. This step gets the key from the RCP portal.

login.waiting: A portal window is open. Log in with your EPFL account. This window continues when you are logged in.

choice.title: An OpenWork key already exists
choice.text: Your account may already have an OpenWork key. Reuse the existing key, or create a second key with a new name.

token.title: Your key is ready
token.label: Token of {name}
token.warning: The clipboard now holds a secret. Paste it only in OpenCode, then clear the clipboard.

manual.title: Do it yourself in the browser
manual.intro: If the portal window does not work, create or copy the key in your browser.
manual.step1: Log in to the RCP portal with your EPFL account.
manual.step2: Create an OpenWork key, or copy the token of the existing key.
manual.step3: Paste the token in the field below.

providerConfig.title: RCP provider
providerConfig.intro: This step adds the EPFL RCP AIaaS provider to your global OpenCode configuration. Other providers and your own settings stay untouched.
providerConfig.success: The RCP provider is in your OpenCode configuration.
providerConfig.unchanged: The RCP provider is already configured. Nothing was written.
providerConfig.backupCreated: Your previous file was saved as a backup.
providerConfig.invalidJson: The configuration file is not valid JSON. Fix it or move it away, then try again. Details: {detail}
providerConfig.ioError: The configuration file could not be written: {detail}
providerConfig.keyHint: Your RCP API key is written into this file. Keep the file private.
providerConfig.missingKey: No RCP key is available from the previous step.

shell.locked: This step is locked. Finish the previous steps first.

network.title: Network check
network.intro: The installer checks that this computer can reach the EPFL RCP portal. Only key creation needs the EPFL network, the inference endpoint is public.
network.fail: The EPFL network is not reachable. If you are off campus, connect to the EPFL VPN.

opencode.title: OpenCode
opencode.intro: OpenCode provides the AI assistant used by OpenWork.
opencode.missing: OpenCode is not installed on this computer.

smokeTest.title: Smoke test
smokeTest.intro: The smoke test checks that OpenCode works with the configured provider.

openwork.title: OpenWork
openwork.intro: OpenWork is the EPFL work environment this installer installs.
openwork.missing: OpenWork is not installed on this computer.
openwork.stateBrokenDetail: OpenWork stops with the message: Database is not empty and has no session table.
openwork.stateBrokenCause: The cause is a database file that another OpenCode version created. OpenWork expects its own layout in that file, so it stops at start.
openwork.stateBrokenFix: This setup can move the file to a backup and clear it. OpenWork then creates a new database on its next start. The backup keeps the old content, nothing is deleted.
openwork.stateConsent: I agree that this setup moves the database file to a backup.
openwork.stateRepaired: The database is backed up. OpenWork creates a new one on its next start. The backup files are:

summary.title: Summary
summary.intro: Here is what this installer did.
